about: Letters between players (Docs/Design/55-letters-gifts-favours.md, 2). textMost: letters of text at most; perDay: letters a wolf may send a game day; unreadMost: past this many unread, the courier refuses (their post is full); fees in pennies to the writing town's treasury (within a town; to another town, plus one more for each `perCells` road cells); courier hours (game hours: within a town; between towns 1 + cells / `cellsPerHour`, at most `mostHours`); scentDays: game days a letter keeps its writer's scent; sightFamiliarity: how well a reader must know a wolf to know its scent by sight. All numbers are placeholders.
